failed_attempts_and_resolution: The initial RED test exposed missing skills/location search and an over-strict company assertion because the fixture had multiple jobs for one company; the company oracle was corrected to require the target among valid matches.

A PostgreSQL rerun against a database already modified by the prior test conflicted with the fixture source identity. The migration/data-preservation check remained successful; the final API acceptance was rerun from a fresh disposable database and passed.

The first temporary PostgreSQL network was configured internal-only and was unreachable from the host test process. It was replaced with a separate bridge network and loopback-only published port. No existing MJobs container or database was changed.

scope_limitations: PostgreSQL full-text matching uses the simple configuration and AND semantics from websearch_to_tsquery; no separate relevance ranking was added.
SQLite retains portable case-insensitive substring behavior for local tests and development; PostgreSQL production search uses the GIN full-text indexes.
